summary: Records input CHOP audio channels to disk as WAV, OGG, MP3, AIFF, or other supported encoded audio files.
key_concepts: Audio File Out CHOP records an input audio stream from CHOP channels to disk.
File Type selects the output container, including WAV, OGG, MP3, and AIFF.
Codec and bitrate options depend on the chosen file type and control compression or bit depth.
The output file extension must match the selected File Type.
Header Source DAT can write key-value metadata pairs into supported output files.

key_params.name: uniquesuff
key_params.note: Append a unique suffix to avoid overwriting files

key_params.name: codec
key_params.note: Encoding codec or bit depth where applicable

common_gotchas: Recording starts only when Record is enabled; set output paths before pulsing or toggling capture.
Compressed formats trade file size against quality and may introduce latency or codec availability constraints.
Unique suffix protects existing takes during automated runs.
Input sample rate and channel count determine the recorded stream; fix upstream routing before recording.
